sehemu: Part II: The Revolutionary Council of Zanzibar
jina: The Revolutionary Council of Zanzibar and its functions
maudhui: (1) There shall be a Revolutionary Council of Zanzibar consisting of the following members: (a) the Chairman of the Revolutionary Council; (b) the Chief Minister of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar; (c) all Ministers of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar; and (d) other members appointed by the Chairman of the Revolutionary Council in accordance with the Constitution of Zanzibar. (2) Without prejudice to the powers of the Chairman of the Revolutionary Council as Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar, the Revolutionary Council shall be the principal organ for advising the Head of the Revolutionary Government of Zanzibar on all matters concerning the exercise of his executive powers and supervision of the affairs of the Government of Zanzibar, and on the exercise of his authority over all Government affairs relating to matters which are not Union Matters, in accordance with this Constitution and the Constitution of Zanzibar.
